name: lost-in-the-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin suite for the lost-in-the tools: grove (git worktree + tmux manager) and woods (Rails code-intelligence gem). Each plugin is a git-subdir reference into its home repo, so installs fetch only the skill subtree — not the whole codebase.

plugins.name: grove-plugin
plugins.description: Grove worktree management skill: zero-friction git worktree + tmux workflows for AI agents and humans. Requires grove >= 0.8.0.

plugins.name: woods-plugin
plugins.description: Woods user guides: set up, configure MCP servers for, and diagnose the Woods Rails code-intelligence gem (woods-setup, woods-mcp-config, woods-diagnose). Requires woods >= 2.0.0.
